QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are also commented out (lines 2185, 2196). So no mutex implementation is built in.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the shipped config leaves the threading macros (THREADING_C, PTHREAD, ALT) commented out, so none are defined by default.
